name: bytebot-electron
description: Bytebot - Compact AI Automation Desktop App

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && electron-builder
scripts.build:all: cd bytebot/packages/shared && npm run build && cd ../bytebotd && npm run build && cd ../bytebot-agent && npm run build && cd ../bytebot-ui && npm run build
scripts.verify-build: npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const paths = [['bytebot/packages/bytebot-agent/dist', 'bytebot-agent'], ['bytebot/packages/bytebot-ui/out', 'bytebot-ui'], ['bytebot/packages/bytebotd/dist', 'bytebotd']]; paths.forEach(([p, n]) => { if (!fs.existsSync(p)) { console.error('ERROR: Missing ' + n + ' at ' + p); process.exit(1); } console.log('✓ ' + n + ' build verified'); }); console.log('All build artifacts verified!');"
scripts.electron:prod: npm run build:all && node scripts/verify-build.js && electron .

author: Bytebot
